insight: Founded by Gabriel Fairman as a Brazilian translation-services firm in 2005; pivoted to a software platform in 2021.
name: Bureau Works
tagline: AI translation and localization platform for enterprise teams.
description: A translation platform built around a Context Sensitive Translate engine that adapts to each project's content and style rather than relying on static translation memory. Handles end-to-end localization workflow — quoting, task assignment, QA, and payments — across 200+ languages and 50+ file types. Positions LLM-driven context as the core differentiator over generic machine translation.

modelSupport.notes: LLM-backed Context Sensitive Translate engine with dynamic per-project learning.

edge: Its Context Sensitive engine learns each project's style on the fly rather than leaning on static translation memory.
pros: End-to-end workflow: quote, assign, QA, pay
